versions.content: If J1939TpTxRetrySupport is disabled, when a TP.CM_CTS is received while TP.DT messages are being transmitted, J1939Tp shall abort the connection as specified in SWS_J1939Tp_00032 and in SWS_J1939Tp_00097 with connection abort reason 4 (CTS messages received when data transfer is in progress).

If J1939TpTxRetrySupport is disabled, when a TP.CM_CTS is received while TP.DT messages are being transmitted, J1939Tp shall abort the connection as specified in SWS_J1939Tp_00032 and in SWS_J1939Tp_00097 with connection abort reason 4 (CTS messages received when data transfer is in progress).
